name: Auto Update Test Files
description: Automatically update or create test files when service classes are modified

actions.prompt:
A service class has been modified at ${file_path}. Please:
1. Check if a corresponding test file exists
2. If it exists, update it to match any new methods or changes
3. If it doesn't exist, create a comprehensive test file
4. Ensure all public methods are tested
5. Use Jest testing framework
6. Follow the existing test patterns in the project
actions.output_instruction: Create or update the test file in the appropriate __tests__ directory
